EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
THE URBAN DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY LAW No. 41 OF 1978 ENACTED BY THE NATIONALSTATE ASSEMBLY

BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 15 of the Urban Development Authority Law No. 41 of 1978 enactedby the National State Assembly, I, Patali Champika Ranawaka, Minister of Megapolis and Western Development do by thisOrder vest with the Urban Development Authority, with effect from today, the land situated at Dematagoda in WanathamullaWard within the limits of the Municipal Council of Colombo described morefully in the Schedule hereto, being the landcalled “Slaughter House for Sheep” belonging to the Colombo Municipal Council
PATALI CHAMPIKA RANAWAKA (M.P.),Minister of Megapolis and Western Development.
Ministry of Megapolis and Western Development,17th and 18th Floors,“Suhurupaya”,Sri Subuthipura Road,Battaramulla,18th November 2016.

Allotment of land in extent of 02A., 01R., 3.77P. depicted as Lot No. 01 in Plan No. 33/2012 dated 30.07.2012prepared by Registered Licensed Surveyor T. R. de Zoysa situated at Dr. Danister de Silva Mawatha in Dematagoda WardNo. 30, Wanathamulla within the Municipal Council limits of Colombo in the District of Colombo, Western Provincebounded as follows :
North:Private Land ;East:Land bearing Asst. Nos. G 247, 243 Dr. Danister De Silva Mawatha ;South:Land bearing Asst. Nos. 4 to 28 Mount Pleasant Road ;West:Muslim Burial Ground.
